title: opcua-adapter component configuration
description: The configuration the OPC UA adapter itself understands: the object at `component.global`, with each entry of `component.instances[]` validated against `#/$defs/device`. A southbound adapter models ONE OPC UA SERVER PER INSTANCE — how to reach it, how to secure the channel, which signals to subscribe, and what it is permitted to write. See docs/SOUTHBOUND.md for the contract this implements and docs/reference/configuration.md for the full prose. The library envelope (logging, messaging, metricEmission, heartbeat, credentials, parameters, health, hierarchy, identity, topic, tags) is owned by the canonical schema and is deliberately not redeclared here.

defaults.description: Subscription defaults applied to every signal matcher (and every instance) that does not override them.

publishIntervalMs.description: Default OPC UA subscription publish interval, in milliseconds. Also the fallback for `publish.batchMs`.

samplingRateMs.description: Default monitored-item sampling interval, in milliseconds (0 lets the server choose).

browse.description: Bounds on address-space traversal. A server with a very large or cyclic address space must not be able to make discovery unbounded.

maxNodes.description: Variable nodes collected in one browse before the traversal reports itself truncated. A truncated browse never replaces the cache on `sb/rescan`.

maxDepth.description: Hierarchy levels descended in one browse.

limits.description: Bounds on command execution. Requests arrive over the bus, so every batch size and every blocking call is capped.

maxReadTargets.description: Signals one `sb/read` may name (explicit plus include-matched, after de-duplication). A request over the cap is refused with `BAD_ARGS` rather than silently truncated, so a caller never mistakes a partial read for a complete one.

maxWriteTargets.description: Entries one `sb/write` batch may carry. Over the cap is refused with `BAD_ARGS`.

commandTimeoutMs.description: Deadline on a single blocking OPC UA service call. On expiry the command answers `DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE` instead of parking the command thread.

chunkSize.description: Fallback nodes-per-service-call when the server publishes no `MaxNodesPerRead`/`MaxNodesPerWrite` operation limit. When it does publish one, the smaller of the two applies.

maxBufferedSamples.description: Samples buffered per signal between batch flushes. At capacity the oldest are discarded and counted on `OpcUaSubscription.DroppedSample*`, so backpressure loss is visible rather than silent.

staleSignalSecs.description: A subscribed signal with no update for longer than this many seconds counts toward `southbound_health.staleSignals`. A signal that silently stops updating is otherwise indistinguishable from one that is simply not changing — which is why staleness is measured rather than assumed.

instance.description: The shape of one `component.instances[]` entry. Tooling resolves instance config through this fixed name; the definition lives under its domain name below.

device.title: One OPC UA server
device.description: One entry of `component.instances[]`. Each server gets its own connection lifecycle, subscriptions, and command routing (addressed by `id`).

id.description: Unique instance id. It is the `{instance}` token of this server's UNS topics and the `instance` dimension of its health metric, and the routing key for `sb/*` commands, so it must be stable.

adapter.description: The protocol backend. Published in the `device.adapter` field of every SouthboundSignalUpdate.

connection.description: How to reach the server. Deliberately OPEN — a secure connection adds a certificate source (`vault`/`file`/`pkcs11`) and an identity `user` block, documented in docs/reference/configuration.md and the security how-to.

endpoint.description: The OPC UA endpoint URL, e.g. `opc.tcp://host:4840/`. Published in the `device.endpoint` field.

securityPolicy.description: Milo SecurityPolicy enum name. `None` is anonymous/unencrypted; anything else requests a secure channel and requires `messageMode` to be `Sign` or `SignAndEncrypt`. An unrecognized value fails the instance at startup — it is never treated as `None`, because a typo must not silently downgrade an intended encrypted session to plaintext.

messageMode.description: Milo MessageSecurityMode for a secure channel.

user.description: Optional UserName identity token — inline (`{username, password}`) or vault-backed (`{source:"vault", secret:"…"}`). Absent = anonymous.

publish.description: Publish batching. The data-plane topic is UNS-minted (SOUTHBOUND.md §2.0), never a config template.

batchMs.description: Buffer window (ms) for coalescing a signal's value changes into one message. 0 publishes each change immediately. Defaults to the resolved `publishIntervalMs`.

allow.description: Stable signal ids that `sb/write` may write, in the canonical `nsu=<namespaceUri>;<i|s|g|b>=<identifier>` form (or `ns=0;…` in namespace 0), or the wildcard `"*"`. A namespace INDEX (`ns=2;…`) is rejected: an index is a per-session handle, so an index-keyed entry can refuse a legitimate write after the server renumbers, or authorize a different node that has taken over the old index. Anything not listed is refused, whatever a command asks for. An empty list — the default — means the adapter is read-only, the correct posture for anything touching a control system.

subscriptions.description: The OPC UA subscriptions this server serves. Each is a publish interval plus include/exclude signal matchers.

id.description: Subscription id (a random id is used when omitted).

publishIntervalMs.description: Subscription publish interval (ms). Defaults to the resolved instance `publishIntervalMs`.

signalMatcher.title: A signal matcher
signalMatcher.description: Selects nodes by namespace + regex. The namespace is identified by `namespaceUri` (preferred — resolved to the server's current index at runtime) or a literal `namespace` index.

namespace.description: Literal namespace index; used only when `namespaceUri` is absent.

namespaceUri.description: Namespace URI (preferred), resolved to the server's current index at runtime.

match.description: Regex applied to the node identifier, browse name, or display name (identifier only, for `exclude`).

samplingRateMs.description: Per-matcher monitored-item sampling interval (ms). Defaults to the resolved instance `samplingRateMs`.

queueSize.description: Per-matcher monitored-item queue size. Defaults to the resolved instance `queueSize`.

value.description: Deadband magnitude (absolute units, or percent for `Percent`).
